marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming northwest 15 knots this afternoon then
diminishing to light Friday morning. Scattered showers changing to scattered flurries this
evening. Fog patches dissipating near noon. Temperatures plus 5 falling to zero
overnight. <br/>

Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 this evening then
subsiding to 1 or less near noon Friday.<br/>
